about: Relations inside components over GraphQL, checked against strapi-php's GraphQL plugin. Seeds component-vectors.json's authors, topics and menus over REST, then posts each query and mutation in order to /graphql with strapi-populate-vectors.mjs. A published menu shows each linked topic's published version, so the draft-only Hidden topic stays out. publishedAt is compared as present or absent; documentId, id and the timestamps are left out.

reads.name: an embedded component's relations, to one and to many
reads.graphql: { menus(sort: "title") { title cta { label author { name } topics(sort: "name") { name } } } }

reads.name: a to-many relation in a component as a connection
a component's relation, filtered
reads.graphql: { menu(documentId: "@menus:Main") { cta { topics(filters: { name: { eq: "News" } }) { name } } } }

reads.name: relations inside a repeatable's items, a component in them and a repeatable in them
reads.graphql: { menu(documentId: "@menus:Main") { items { label link { label author { name } topics { name } } children { label author { name } topics(sort: "name") { name } } } } }

reads.name: relations inside a dynamic zone's items
reads.graphql: { menu(documentId: "@menus:Main") { sections { __typename ... on ComponentSharedLink { label author { name } topics { name } } ... on ComponentSharedMenuItem { itemLabel: label link { label author { name } } children { label author { name } topics { name } } } } } }

reads.name: a list filtered by a relation inside a component
reads.graphql: { menus(filters: { cta: { author: { name: { eq: "Bob" } } } }) { title } }

writes.name: create a menu with relations inside its components
writes.graphql: mutation { createMenu(data: { title: "Side", cta: { label: "Go", author: "@authors:Bob", topics: ["@topics:News", "@topics:Sport"] }, items: [{ label: "One", link: { label: "Inner", author: "@authors:Ann" }, children: [{ label: "Kid", topics: ["@topics:Sport"] }] }] }) { documentId title cta { label author { name } topics(sort: "name") { name } } items { label link { label author { name } } children { label topics { name } } } } }

writes.name: update a menu's component relations
writes.graphql: mutation { updateMenu(documentId: "@menus:Side", data: { cta: { label: "Went", author: "@authors:Ann", topics: [] } }) { title cta { label author { name } topics { name } } } }
